build_mujoco_mpc_package: build the mujoco_mpc Python package with protobuf and gRPC compilation
generate_proto_grpc_files: generate agent_pb2 and agent_pb2_grpc Python files from agent.proto using grpc_tools.protoc
build_cmake_agent_server: build the agent_server and ui_agent_server C++ gRPC binaries with CMake
copy_agent_server_binary: copy agent_server and ui_agent_server binaries into the build lib directory
copy_task_assets: copy task XML, PNG, STL, and OBJ assets from build/mjpc/tasks into the package
